project_type: Python HTTP server with vanilla JS/HTML frontend - PV solar simulator
build_system: No build system - plain Python stdlib HTTP server, no dependencies beyond stdlib
test_framework: unittest with discover, tests in backend/tests/test_*.py
verification_instructions: Run python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p 'test_*.py' from project root. All 386+ tests must pass.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure Python stdlib, no external dependencies
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. No external packages needed.
contribution_requirements: After implementation: git add -A && git commit && git push origin main. Update .kiro/backups/SESSION-LOG.md chronology.
key_patterns: Backend uses dataclasses for models, handler functions return Tuple[int, dict], main.py registers routes manually with if/elif. Frontend is vanilla JS with localStorage for state. Dark theme Solar Pro with amber/gold accents (#f59e0b). CSS vars defined in style.css.
directory_structure: backend/ (api/, services/, models/, tests/, data/tmy_cache/), frontend/ (pages/, css/, js/), .kiro/backups/
